note: Portraits of the winners of the 2024 Lok Sabha general election, one file per constituency, named by the geometry unique_id (data/geo/india-pcs.json). Fetched from the Lok Sabha Secretariat member directory and downscaled to 170px on the long edge (2x the 68x85 display slot).
source_publisher: Lok Sabha Secretariat, Government of India
licence_note: No explicit reuse licence is stated by the source. Government of India material is generally covered by GODL-India, but this has NOT been confirmed for these portraits specifically — establish it before relying on this directory.
join: state + constituency against data/results/ls/pc/2024.json, then verified against the ECI 2024 declared winner in data/results/ls/detail/2024.json.
caveat: The directory lists members currently sitting, so it is valid for 2024 only. Seats whose member is not the general-election winner (i.e. a by-election has since been held) have been replaced by that winner's portrait from elsewhere in the same directory — see "by_election_corrections".
